# Acme Analytics Master Services Agreement Draft

## Draft Status

Draft ID: MSA-ACME-2025-DRAFT

Status: superseded draft, not signed.

This draft was replaced before execution of MSA-ACME-2026.

## Draft Termination for Convenience

Either party may terminate this draft agreement for convenience by giving 30 days' written notice.

## Draft Security Incident Notice

The provider must notify the customer within 72 hours after discovering a suspected security incident.

## Draft Liability Cap

The provider's aggregate liability under this draft is capped at $1,000,000.
